description: This file defines the AuthSchemeResolver class in the Aws\Auth namespace, which contains logic for selecting an authentication scheme based on provided schemes and identities. It handles mapping, compatibility checks, and exception handling for auth schemes in AWS SDK.

classes.name: AuthSchemeResolver
classes.description: Implements logic for resolving and selecting authentication schemes for AWS SDK requests, supporting various schemes and handling identity compatibility.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the resolver with credential, token providers, and an optional custom auth scheme map.

methods.name: selectAuthScheme
methods.description: Chooses the first compatible auth scheme from a list, returning the normalized scheme or throwing an exception if none are compatible.

methods.name: isCompatibleAuthScheme
methods.description: Checks if a given auth scheme is compatible based on available credentials and extensions.

methods.name: getIncompatibilityMessage
methods.description: Returns a message explaining why a particular auth scheme is incompatible.

methods.name: hasAwsCredentialIdentity
methods.description: Determines if AWS credentials are available, resolving promises if needed.

methods.name: hasBearerTokenIdentity
methods.description: Checks if a bearer token identity is available, resolving promises if needed.
